solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Stuff of great importance

definitions.meaning: first meaning: substance or fabric, as a noun
second meaning: significant or relevant, as an adjective

explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a phrase about weighty matters, but it splits into a noun meaning and an adjective meaning of one word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names cloth or substance, and as an adjective describes evidence or facts that are relevant and significant.

clue.text: Millions question cover of The Face

parts.note: M is the standard abbreviation for million
to question someone is to ask them

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a magazine cover cost millions, The Face being a style magazine.
explanation.walkthrough: The capitalised The Face suggests the old style magazine, but the definition just means something worn over a face.
explanation.definitionFit: A disguise or protective covering worn over the face is exactly what this item is.

clue.text: Cut surface of top lip

indicators.note: the surface of something is its uppermost layer, so only the top letter of the next word is kept

parts.note: the first letter of top
the lip of a cup or bowl is its rim

explanation.surface: A barber shaves or trims the hair on someone's upper lip.
explanation.definitionFit: To trim is to cut back slightly, as with hair or a hedge.

clue.text: Sailor in New Orleans beginning to enjoy fair

indicators.note: the seaman is placed within the rearranged city letters
something made new is remade, so the place name's letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
AB, able seaman, is the usual crossword sailor

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its opening letter, so only that one is taken

parts.note: the first letter of enjoy

explanation.surface: A sailor on shore leave in New Orleans is starting to enjoy the city's fair.
explanation.walkthrough: New Orleans reads as one place, but New is the signal to rearrange Orleans; the sailor goes inside before the final L.
explanation.definitionFit: Reasonable and fair are synonyms, both describing something just, moderate and sensible.

clue.text: Troubling flaw initially ignored

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word is to be left out, as if passed over

parts.note: a failing is a weakness or flaw

explanation.surface: Someone finds a defect worrying because it was overlooked at first.
explanation.walkthrough: To ail someone is to trouble them, as in 'what's ailing you?', so the participle matches 'Troubling'.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb ail means to trouble or afflict, so its present participle carries the sense of troubling.

clue.text: Member of Muslim Brotherhood

indicators.note: the letters are part of the following words, sitting inside them

parts.note: found across the end of the first word and start of the second

explanation.surface: Describes someone who belongs to the Muslim Brotherhood organisation.
explanation.definitionFit: An arm or leg is a member of the body, an old anatomical sense.

clue.text: Position supporting popular case

indicators.note: in a down entry, a piece supporting another sits beneath it

parts.note: something in is fashionable or popular
a stance is a position or attitude

explanation.surface: Someone takes a stance in favour of a popular legal case.
explanation.definitionFit: An instance is an example or case, as in 'in this case' or 'for instance'.

clue.text: Save one high note for male singer

parts.note: save and bar both mean except
the Roman numeral for one
the ton is high society or high fashion
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A choir master asks to keep one high note for the male voice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High note' looks like a single musical idea, but high and note are separate pieces; the ton is an old word for fashionable society.
explanation.definitionFit: A baritone is a man whose voice lies between tenor and bass, so he is a male singer.

clue.text: Appropriate executive having the necessary power?

parts.note: a suit is slang for a business executive
being able means having the power to do something

explanation.surface: Asks whether a business executive has the authority a role needs.
explanation.definitionFit: Suitable and appropriate are synonyms, both meaning right or fitting for a purpose.

clue.text: Attendant giving away heroin for addict

indicators.note: giving something away means losing it, so that letter is dropped

parts.note: an usher is an attendant who shows people to seats
H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: A worker is caught passing drugs to an addict.
explanation.definitionFit: A user is everyday slang for a drug taker, someone who uses narcotics habitually.

clue.text: Corrupt, heartless duke upset teenager

indicators.note: without its heart a word loses its middle and keeps only its two ends

parts.note: the outside letters of duke

indicators.note: something upset is knocked into disorder, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A cruel aristocrat has upset a young person, a picture of decadent nobility.
explanation.definitionFit: Degenerate means morally debased, which is what corrupt describes.

clue.text: Moderate effects of law on sales position

indicators.note: in an across entry, one piece on another follows straight after it

parts.note: a shop counter is where sales are made
an act of parliament is a law

explanation.surface: Considers how legislation moderates the effects of a firm's sales strategy.
explanation.definitionFit: To counteract something is to act against it and so lessen or neutralise its effects.

clue.text: Tough ocean-going vessel in distress

parts.note: tough and hard are synonyms
a ship is a vessel that sails the sea

explanation.surface: A sturdy seagoing boat is in difficulty and signalling for help.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardship is suffering or privation, the same as distress in its sense of trouble.

clue.text: Protect company name and start to rally

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company
N is the abbreviation for name
in tennis a serve starts each rally

explanation.surface: A firm guards its brand name and begins to recover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Start to rally' looks like it wants a first letter, but it is a tennis rally, which begins with a serve.
explanation.definitionFit: To conserve is to keep something safe from harm or waste, which is to protect it.

clue.text: A & E possibly read out formal statement

indicators.note: reading something out means saying it, so the answer is a word that matches how the phrase is pronounced

parts.note: A and E are both examples of a vowel

explanation.surface: A hospital's accident and emergency department issues an official statement.
explanation.walkthrough: A & E is the British term for a hospital emergency department, but here it is just two letters, each an example of a vowel.
explanation.definitionFit: An avowal is an open declaration or affirmation, a formal statement of belief.

clue.text: Drug Enforcement Administration meeting Conservative minister

indicators.note: two pieces meeting are placed side by side, joined end to end

parts.note: the initials of the US drugs agency
CON is the abbreviation for Conservative

explanation.surface: American drug agents hold talks with a Tory government minister.
explanation.definitionFit: A deacon is an ordained church minister ranking below a priest.

clue.text: Refuse to acknowledge drink controls lives

indicators.note: something that controls another holds it in its grip, so it wraps around it

parts.note: to down a drink is to swallow it
to live is to be, so lives gives the verb is

explanation.surface: A warning that alcohol takes over people's lives, so someone denies their habit.
explanation.definitionFit: To disown someone or something is to deny any connection with them, refusing to acknowledge them.

clue.text: Record wrong email and right denial

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record

indicators.note: something wrong is out of order, so these letters are scrambled

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Someone keeps a record of a mistaken message and a proper denial.
explanation.definitionFit: A disclaimer is a statement disavowing responsibility, which is a denial of it.

clue.text: Mention something worth seeing to audience

indicators.note: what an audience gets is what it hears, so the word is chosen for its sound

parts.note: a sight is something worth seeing, as in tourist sights

explanation.surface: A presenter tells listeners about an attraction worth a visit.
explanation.definitionFit: To cite something is to quote or refer to it, which is to mention it.

clue.text: Aquatic bird's speed over water

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a wading shorebird of the sandpiper family
second meaning: a nautical mile per hour, a unit for ships

explanation.walkthrough: The possessive makes it a bird's swimming speed, but 's is just 'is' joining two separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The knot is a sandpiper-like wading bird, and a knot is also the unit measuring a vessel's speed at sea.

clue.text: Crowd received news on the radio

indicators.note: radio is heard rather than seen, so the word is chosen by its sound

parts.note: someone who has received news has heard it

explanation.surface: A crowd of people hear news through a radio broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: A herd is a large group of animals, and by extension a mass of people moving together.

clue.text: People keeping books as system for recording information

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold on to it, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: a nation is a people
OT, the Old Testament, is a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: People retain ledgers as their method of recording data.
explanation.definitionFit: A notation is a set of symbols for writing down information, such as musical or mathematical notation.

clue.text: US writer last to perform his work

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe, the American writer

indicators.note: the last of a word is its final letter, so only that one is kept

parts.note: the final letter of perform

explanation.surface: An American author is the final one to recite his writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'His' points back to Poe, so the definition is a piece of Poe's own writing.
explanation.definitionFit: Poe wrote many verse works such as The Raven, so a poem is an example of his work.

clue.text: Obscene broadcast enticed men, but not me

indicators.note: broadcast suggests scattered widely, so the letters are strewn into a new order
excluding me means those two letters are removed from the word before it

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
taken as written, before two letters are removed

explanation.surface: A lewd programme lured male viewers, the speaker insisting they were not among them.
explanation.definitionFit: Indecent and obscene both describe something offending against standards of sexual propriety.
